# PiTTy 0.6.54

- Display the exact outstanding `ask_parent` question and context in the subagent inspector. Requires `pi-subagent` v0.5.11 for the question fields.
- Fix lost-looking repeated queued messages, preserve separate FIFO follow-ups, and prevent accidental duplicate submissions while awaiting an RPC acknowledgement.

Validated: 655 tests passed (1 skipped), TypeScript passed.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.54` to stage the release; it activates on the next normal launch.
